categories.main_business_segments: Paiho Shih Holdings Corporation primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of hook and loop fasteners, woven bands (including shoelaces), elastic bands, jacquard mesh fabrics, and related materials used in apparel, footwear, 3C products, medical, and sports goods. The company also has real estate operations involving the sale of apartments, commercial offices, and parking spaces. Its main operational entities are subsidiaries in China (Jiangsu Paihong Composite Materials Technology Co., Ltd. and Dongguan Paihong Industrial Co., Ltd.) and Vietnam (Vietnam Paihong Co., Ltd.), with additional investments in Indonesia and other regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced textile manufacturing technologies including warp knitting, jacquard weaving, and ultrasonic welding for hook and loop fasteners. It emphasizes R&D in product design, process optimization, and equipment innovation, holding patents in 3D warp knitting and ultrasonic welding equipment. Production processes are highly automated and digitally controlled to ensure high efficiency, quality, and standardization. The company also integrates digital and smart factory technologies to enhance production management and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Paiho serves a diverse customer base including international and Chinese brands in apparel, footwear, sportswear, medical supplies, and 3C electronics industries. Its products are widely used in consumer goods, sports equipment, medical devices, and electronic accessories. The company is a key supplier to major global sports and apparel brands and collaborates closely with customers for product development and customization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China (Jiangsu, Dongguan, Wuxi, Shanghai), Vietnam, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. It has production, R&D, and sales facilities in these regions, strategically positioned to serve the Greater China area and Southeast Asia markets. The company also maintains international investment and trading subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Samoa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Paiho operates mainly in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on the production of textile components such as hook and loop fasteners, woven bands, elastic bands, and jacquard mesh fabrics. It sources raw materials like nylon monofilament and multifilament yarns from upstream suppliers and supplies finished textile components downstream to apparel, footwear, medical, and electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in functional textiles with enhanced comfort, health, protection, and convenience features. It invests over 5% of revenue in R&D, focusing on product differentiation, environmental sustainability, and digital transformation. Key R&D initiatives include developing anti-static, antibacterial, waterproof, moisture-wicking, and elastic textiles, as well as integrating digital design and smart manufacturing technologies. The company aims to deepen industry-academia collaboration and become a high-end textile solution provider.
categories.revenue_model: Paiho generates revenue primarily through product sales of textile components and related materials. It also earns income from real estate sales and international investment activities. The company’s sales are conducted through direct sales channels, supported by digital marketing platforms and integrated e-commerce systems to enhance customer engagement and service.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from numerous manufacturers producing similar textile components, often competing on price when lacking brand or functional differentiation. Paiho maintains a competitive edge through strong R&D capabilities, high product quality, environmental certifications, and close partnerships with leading international and Chinese brands. Its comprehensive production and sales network across China and Southeast Asia further strengthens its market position as a leading supplier in the hook and loop fastener and woven band industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Paiho reported net revenue of approximately NT$7 billion, representing a 32.8% increase from the previous year, with net profit turning positive at NT$368 million after prior losses. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased market demand and new product development. Total assets stood at about NT$18.2 billion with equity of NT$6.6 billion, reflecting a solid financial base and improving profitability. The company continues to expand production capacity and invest in R&D to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Paiho emphasizes high product quality, functional innovation, and environmental sustainability as its core value propositions. It offers a wide range of differentiated textile components with enhanced features such as anti-static, antibacterial, waterproof, and elastic properties tailored to customer needs. The company’s integrated R&D, manufacturing, and digital marketing capabilities enable customized solutions and rapid response to market trends, positioning it as a strategic partner to leading global and Chinese brands. Its commitment to green manufacturing and certifications further differentiates it in the competitive textile materials market.
